title: PPO clipped surrogate loss
summary: The PPO loss to minimize from new and old log probabilities and advantages, the clip fraction, and the gradient with respect to the new log probabilities.

mutants.clip_ignores_sign: Counts every ratio outside [1 - eps, 1 + eps] as clipped, also when the min keeps the unclipped term.
mutants.grad_ignores_clip: Returns minus r A / N for every sample, also for the clipped samples.
mutants.max_not_min: Takes the larger of the two terms with np.maximum, so the objective is not a lower bound.
mutants.ratio_from_probs: Computes the ratio as exp(logp_new) / exp(logp_old), which gives 0 / 0 for very small probabilities.
mutants.sign_flipped: Returns the surrogate and its gradient without the minus sign, so gradient descent makes the policy worse.
mutants.sum_not_mean: Sums over the samples and does not divide the loss and the gradient by N.
